Pick a tile = 
edited = 
Commands for the assistant = 
Type them or dictate them with the microphone button, in your own words: the assistant understands them even if they are not identical. Tiles are named like on a chessboard: A1 is the top-left one. = 
Zooming in and enhancing a tile = 
• "zoom" into C4": opens the tile, which becomes a new board you can divide again\n• "enhance C4": Real-ESRGAN enlarges it ×2, ×3 or ×4 and rebuilds the detail ("enhance C4 ×2 with the drawing model")\n• "zoom with AI into C4": enhances it and then opens it, to go even deeper\n• "divide into 4×4", "2×2 grid": changes the board of the current level\n• "find the plate and make it readable", "zoom on the face": if the assistant sees the image, it picks the tiles itself\n• "go back", "whole image", "save C4 as PNG", "save everything" = 
Edits = 
• "sharpen C4", "remove the noise", "auto levels": for dull, blurry or grainy photos\n• "brighten", "more contrast", "warmer", "black and white", "straighten the horizon"\n• "hide the plate in D4" (pixelate), "undo the last edit", "put C4 back to the original" = 
Like in Blade Runner = 
In the film Blade Runner (Ridley Scott, 1982) Rick Deckard examines a photograph with the Esper machine by giving spoken orders: he zooms in, moves around, zooms in again, until he finds what he is looking for in a reflection and asks for a hard copy. In the AI grid you can do the same, by voice too with the microphone button:\n• "enhance": enhances the selected tile and goes into it\n• "track right": moves to the next tile; left, up and down too\n• "center in on the window": selects the tile with what you name\n• "pull back": back to the previous level\n• "stop": the assistant stops\n• "give me a hard copy": saves the tile\nTry: "Zoom into B3. Enhance. Track right. Enhance again. Stop. Give me a hard copy."\nUnlike in the film, the AI rebuilds plausible detail but cannot reveal what is not in the photo: an unreadable plate stays a guess. = 
Write what you want to do, for example: "enhance F3 and save it", "divide into 4×4 and zoom into B2", "find the plate and make it readable". All the commands, Blade Runner style too: Commands, above, or type ?. =
